items.title: Server-side life tracking
items.note: Spawn, death, disconnect/reconnect, and respawn are all tracked automatically. No player action required.

items.title: Death-cause detection
items.note: Distinguishes infected, fall, and self-inflicted deaths. Unclassified deaths are labeled "Unknown" rather than guessed.

items.title: Durable upload queue across server restarts
items.note: A disk-backed queue so a server crash doesn't lose data that hasn't been uploaded yet.

items.title: Starvation / dehydration death detection
items.note: Detecting deaths caused by starvation or dehydration using health readings at the moment of death.

items.title: Player-vs-player death detection
items.note: Detecting and attributing deaths caused by another player.

items.title: In-game opt-out command
items.note: A chat command that lets a player opt out of tracking on a server where it's enabled.

items.title: Mid-life event tracking
items.note: Capturing notable in-life moments, like going unconscious, breaking a leg, or firing a weapon, in addition to spawn and death.

items.title: Interactive route viewer
items.note: Pan, zoom (up to 24x), reset view, and a scrub/playback timeline. Works on desktop and touch devices.

items.title: Vector route rendering
items.note: Routes stay crisp at any zoom level instead of blurring.

items.title: Licensed map tiling
items.note: Real map tiling (for example Leaflet) so the map stays sharp at any zoom level.

items.title: Additional official and community map support
items.note: Supporting more DayZ maps beyond Chernarus, both official Bohemia releases and popular community maps.

items.title: Additional map themes and colors
items.note: Alternate visual themes and color palettes for the route viewer.

items.title: "Copy Link" death-screen button
items.note: A lightweight companion mod adds a one-click button to copy your record link when you die.

items.title: In-game chat command fallback
items.note: A !mylink-style command to retrieve your most recent link without the companion mod.

items.title: Push notification before respawn
items.note: Automatic link delivery at the moment of death, before respawn.

items.title: Manual server onboarding
items.note: Server owners are issued a credential directly by the project during this beta.

items.title: Self-service server registration
items.note: A dashboard for server owners to register and manage their own server without manual onboarding.

items.title: Configurable sampling / route fidelity
items.note: Letting server admins tune tracking frequency against server cost.

items.title: Automated retention cleanup
items.note: Running the cleanup job that clears abandoned, never-finished records on a regular automatic schedule.

items.title: Retention and deletion policy
items.note: Completed records are kept until deleted; abandoned/incomplete ones expire automatically after 30 days.

items.title: Self-service record deletion
items.note: A "delete my record" button, instead of going through the server owner or project operator.

items.title: Personal data export
items.note: Exporting your own recorded data in a personal, downloadable format.

items.title: Public source code and issue tracker
items.note: A public, open-source repository with an issue tracker for bug reports and feature requests.

items.title: Community sharing / galleries
items.note: A place to browse and share notable journeys from across the community.
